queue.item: D30 CRITICAL  S3/S3b are still live in production. Space Jamessfks/mace-api at Space commit 992fdb5 (last modified 2026-08-23) serves the unmerged polish branch: main.py:27-35 patches torch.load to weights_only=False process-wide, POST /calculate writes an uploaded `model` to disk and loads it with MACECalculator(model_paths=...) (calculate.py:419-429), CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with credentials, and requirements.txt is unpinned (>=).  [Hugging Face Space (outside the repo); fixed in code by v2.2 (ADR-0020)]

D31 HIGH  v2.2.0 as tagged cannot be built or deployed: mace-api/requirements.lock.txt pins torch==2.10.0+cpu but names no PyTorch CPU index, so `pip install --require-hashes` finds no distribution. v2.2's only CI run is red and the Space deploy was skipped. Local gates on macOS pass only because a macOS env installs torch 2.10.0 from PyPI (this audit stripped +cpu to build one) — local green is not CI green.  [mace-api/requirements.lock.txt:1-3 (no --index-url / --extra-index-url lines), :1946]

D32 HIGH  Production MACE Link table is still world-listable with the public anon key: 18 rows are enumerable. migrations/0003_lockdown.sql has not been applied (S5 is fixed in v2.2 code only).  [Supabase project (outside the repo); supabase/migrations/0003_lockdown.sql]

D33 HIGH  A request for device 'cuda' on a machine without CUDA silently runs on CPU in every path, with no result.warnings entry and no requestedDevice. Measured on CLI (local + hosted profiles), FastAPI /calculate and /v1/jobs (both profiles), Next /api/calculate and /api/jobs (local mode), and the UI: params.device 'cpu', manifest.runtime.device 'cpu', warnings absent. The UI keeps 'CUDA (GPU)' selected, the 'What will run' ledger omits the device, and the timing reads '0.16 s compute' with no device; 'cpu' appears only inside a params string.  [mace-api/calculate.py:374-384; components/calculate/parameter-panel.tsx:422-437; components/calculate/run-ledger.tsx; components/calculate/metrics-dashboard.tsx:330-345,1857]

D58 HIGH  A result is not pinned to the run that produced it: the dashboard filename, Share and 'Compare with foundation model' read live form state, so uploading another file after a run publishes the old numbers under the new filename as a permanent MACE Link, and Compare runs the foundation model on the new structure against the old result.  [app/calculate/page.tsx:392-406,490,704,748]

D34 MEDIUM  Docs promise a CPU fallback when CUDA runs out of memory; no out-of-memory handling exists anywhere in the backend. The FAQ's OOM advice suggests a smaller model size, but the default MACE-MPA-0 is published in one size.  [app/docs/calculations/page.tsx:276-281; app/docs/faq/page.tsx:39-45]

D36 MEDIUM  The docs tell users to change the MD seed to generate independent replicas, but the calculator has no seed input; only API callers can set it.  [app/docs/calculations/page.tsx:170-176; components/calculate/parameter-panel.tsx (no 'seed')]

D38 MEDIUM  The validator's self-test (the gate called 'the scientific gate') runs MACE-OFF geometry optimisation in float32 and calls upstream mace_mp/mace_off directly, so `all_passed: true` says nothing about SimpleAtom's engine, and its geometry-opt test contradicts CLAUDE.md's float64-for-optimisation rule. Its Si test uses MACE-MP-0 small, not the default MPA-0.  [test_scripts/validate_calculation.py:334,350,363-380]

D42 MEDIUM  The hosted per-visitor cap (30 requests/hour) is smaller than one benchmark the hosted profile allows, so a permitted benchmark fails part-way with 429s recorded as per-pair errors.  [mace-api/jobs.py (rate window); mace-api/contract.json profiles.hosted maxBenchmarkStructures; app/api/benchmark/route.ts:245-251]

D44 MEDIUM  Resource bounds leak: the `_submissions` table grows on every request, refused ones included, and uploads up to 30 MB are fully received and spooled before the 2 MB hosted cap or the 401 apply.  [mace-api/jobs.py:63,74; mace-api/main.py:121-134,209-217,249-257]

D45 MEDIUM  Synchronous /calculate keeps running after the client disconnects and holds the single worker and the visitor's slot; its wait counts queue time, so a job that never started is cancelled with 504; a cancel during a step-less phase (single point) is not honoured and the job later reports 'succeeded'.  [mace-api/main.py:264-269; mace-api/jobs.py]

D46 MEDIUM  A geometry optimisation that converges on the step at which the time budget runs out (or stops before step 0) is labelled 'DID NOT CONVERGE … still above fmax' while reporting max force 0.0378 eV/Å below fmax 0.05.  [mace-api/calculate.py:1103-1126,~1148]

D47 MEDIUM  MACE-OFF's element list in the registry is never enforced: a structure with Na or Cl-only ions fails after the model loads with the opaque 'np.int64(11) is not in list' (400 invalid_request locally, 500 hosted) instead of an unsupported_element refusal before any model I/O. Regression of the guard described in CONTINUE.md ('MACE-OFF element guard implemented but inert').  [mace-api/calculate.py (no element check; grep 'elements' → 0 hits in calculate.py and contract.py); mace-api/contract.json models[MACE-OFF].elements]

D50 MEDIUM  The Space deploy workflow can be run manually (workflow_dispatch) on any branch, skipping the CI gates that the workflow_call path requires, unless the hf-production environment restricts branches (not visible from the repo).  [.github/workflows/deploy-hf-space.yml:13; .github/workflows/ci.yml:152-156]

D52 MEDIUM  MACE-OFF energy-per-atom bands are wrong for ordinary O-rich molecules: the 'typical' band (−600 to −100 eV/atom) flags the water demo (−693.7 eV/atom) in the UI, and CO2 (−1711.7 eV/atom) falls below the enforced −800 floor so the validator says 'Check structure'. The model's own atomic reference energies already put water at about −690 eV/atom. The 2026-10-20 audit deferred composition-aware bounds for halogens only.  [mace-api/contract.json energyConventions.off; components/calculate/metrics-dashboard.tsx:560-572; test_scripts/validate_calculation.py]

D53 MEDIUM  MD summary statistics mislead: 'drift' is last minus first total energy (NVE golden: +0.0009 eV, while the fitted drift is −4.6e-5 eV/ps, opposite sign), and is also reported for NVT/NPT where energy is not conserved; 'mean temperature' averages every frame including warm-up and carries no uncertainty (NVT reports 299.1 K vs an equilibrated 290.2 ± 18.6 K).  [mace-api/calculate.py:1335-1348]

D54 MEDIUM  The pressure reported at the end of MD omits the kinetic (ideal-gas) term (ASE get_stress default), so an NPT run at a 0 GPa target reports 0.303 GPa of virial-only pressure; with the kinetic 0.482 GPa it is 0.785 GPa. The label does not say 'virial'. NPT trajectories also carry no per-frame cell, volume or pressure, so a user cannot see that an 8-atom NPT cell's temperature fluctuations (210 K spread vs 92.6 K canonical) are not canonical.  [mace-api/calculate.py:498 (atoms.get_stress(voigt=True)) and the MD result builder]

D59 MEDIUM  The SMILES box and Ketcher 'Use in calculator' show '[object Object]' for every server error (the error body shape changed to {error:{code,message}}); the benchmark page parses errors with the old shape, always blames the Python backend, and offers a custom-model upload on the hosted profile where it is refused.  [components/calculate/smiles-input.tsx; components/calculate/ketcher-editor.tsx; app/benchmark/page.tsx; components/benchmark/*]

D60 MEDIUM  A non-converged optimisation or a run stopped by the time budget still shows a green 'Calculation complete' banner and a 'Complete' pill; stoppedEarly is never read, and the step-limit wording is wrong for the budget case.  [app/calculate/page.tsx; components/calculate/metrics-dashboard.tsx]

D61 MEDIUM  Accessibility: every Select trigger and NumberField input lacks an accessible name; the benchmark file input is display:none (unreachable by keyboard); the upload input's focus ring is invisible (opacity 0); tab panels take focus with no outline; the job-progress live region contains a ticking timer, and completion is not announced on phones.  [components/calculate/parameter-panel.tsx; components/benchmark/*; components/calculate/file-upload-section.tsx; app/calculate/page.tsx:610,681,852]

D62 MEDIUM  The client CIF parser does not expand symmetry, so for ordinary database CIFs the preview atom count, formula, hosted size limits and overlap warnings are wrong (NaCl shows 2 atoms where ASE reads 8). The backend reads the file correctly.  [lib/parse-structure.ts (parseCIF)]

D63 MEDIUM  Share publishes a permanent public link without telling the user: the client hard-codes consent: true, so the server's consent check (ADR-0024) is satisfied without consent ever being asked.  [lib/share.ts; app/api/share/route.ts:95-97]

D64 MEDIUM  MACE Link renders unvalidated, client-supplied provenance and validation fields as facts; the gitCommit link allows path injection into the GitHub URL, and a crafted 50k-row result can freeze the page.  [app/r/[id]/*; app/api/share/route.ts validateResult()]
D65 MEDIUM  Run lifecycle: navigating away neither aborts nor cancels the job, one failed poll abandons it, and a Cancel pressed during submit is lost.  [app/calculate/page.tsx; lib/api-client.ts]

D66 MEDIUM  The public /v2 dashboard shows stale Matbench ranks (34/21) and says SimpleAtom 'offers it nowhere' about MACE-MPA-0, which is now the default; it also uses #8A8478 text below AA contrast.  [app/v2/* (renders docs/v2 content)]

D67 MEDIUM  Docs describe verification and accuracy the code does not provide: docs/validation describes checks that tests 1 and 2 never run, and the docs home claims 'DFT-level accuracy' without the Matbench-supported qualifier.  [app/docs/validation/page.tsx; app/docs/page.tsx:85]

D68 MEDIUM  'Compare with foundation model' prints an energy difference across two energy conventions without saying which foundation model ran, and the docs promise comparison metrics that are never computed.  [components/calculate/model-comparison.tsx]

D70 MEDIUM  Both catalog slabs (cu-111, si-111) declare pbc="T T T", so the app computes and shows a stress and pressure for them (si-111 −0.146 GPa via the CLI; cu-111 −0.475 GPa), although calculate.py itself says a slab's stress is meaningless. pbc="T T F" leaves energy and forces identical and suppresses it.  [lib/mlpeg-catalog.ts (cu-111, si-111 xyzData); mace-api/calculate.py:489-494]
D15 LOW  Audit findings 6, 9 and 12 from docs/v2/audit-vs-acesuit.md were never closed out. Findings 7, 10 and 11 are recorded as done.  [docs/v2/audit-vs-acesuit.md]

D35 LOW  Neither /capabilities nor GET /api/calculate reports devices, and the contract allows 'cuda' on the hosted profile although the hosted image pins torch==2.10.0+cpu, so the UI cannot know which devices work.  [mace-api/main.py:304-313; app/api/calculate/route.ts:77; mace-api/contract.json:22-25; mace-api/requirements.lock.txt:1946]

D37 LOW  The results 'Limitations and uncertainty' list is static: it shows 'MACE-OFF scope' on MACE-MPA-0 and MACE-MP-0 results and advises running 'multiple model sizes (small/medium/large)', though MPA-0 has one size.  [components/calculate/metrics-dashboard.tsx:660-685]

D39 LOW  Stale facts in the harness docs: Matbench Discovery ranks are given as MACE-MP-0 34 / MACE-MPA-0 21; on 2026-10-28 they are 36 and 22 of 43. SUCCESS-CRITERIA says calculate_local.py exits 0 on refusal; v2.2 exits 1 (the JSON check is still the right one).  [docs/v2/SUCCESS-CRITERIA.md:54,93-97; docs/v2/CONTINUE.md]

D48 LOW  Seed validation coerces and crashes: `seed: Infinity` or a very large integer returns 500 rather than 400, and Python accepts 3.7 and truncates it to 3 while the TypeScript mirror refuses it (CLAUDE.md: never coerce).  [mace-api/contract.py (seed); lib/contract.ts (seed)]

D49 LOW  Deployed manifests report code.gitDirty: null with no note explaining why (the container has no .git), a regression in the D3 fix that made provenance explain every null.  [mace-api/provenance.py:382-385 (pinned-commit fallback resets unavailableReason=None)]

D51 LOW  'Auto' precision resolves MACE-MP-family geometry optimisation from mace_mp()'s float32 default to float64 (ADR-0005 intends this) and records it in params, but adds no result.warnings entry, which CLAUDE.md requires for any override of an upstream dtype default.  [mace-api/calculate.py (precision resolution); CLAUDE.md §Geometry Optimization; docs/adr/0005-precision-follows-upstream.md]

D55 LOW  Parameters that had no effect are echoed as effective: friction is recorded for NVE and NPT, where nothing uses it (CLAUDE.md pitfall 8: echo the effective parameters).  [mace-api/calculate.py (_build_result params allow-list)]

D56 LOW  Docs nits: the Units page table gives stress in eV/Å³ while results and the same page's pressure callout give GPa; the silicon CIF comment says 2.3517 Å (a√3/4 = 2.3516); the optimiser message says 'at or below' fmax while ASE's test is strictly below.  [app/docs/units/page.tsx:57-59 vs :154-157; public/demo/silicon.cif; mace-api/calculate.py (opt message)]

D69 LOW  Lower-severity frontend findings F19–F29 from the 2026-10-28 review: loose convention notes, benchmark wording, swallowed export/clipboard failures, progress stages claimed before the backend reports them, a compare run reusing a stale modelSize, model switched by filename prefix, upload accepting fewer extensions than the contract, contradictory catalog attribution, viewer effects, 32 px docs-nav targets at 375 px, small copy mismatches.  [see review-frontend.md §LOW for each path:line]

D71 LOW  Catalog metadata nits: cu-111's cell vector is rounded to 3 decimals ((1.278, 2.213) vs (1.278096, 2.213726)), leaving 2.6e-4 eV/Å in-plane forces and a 0.0104 GPa σxx–σyy gap; its comment says '20 Å vacuum' where the cell height is 20 Å and the vacuum gap is 15.83 Å; si-diamond's reference lattice constant is 5.431 Å but the cell uses 5.43 Å; 2–3-layer unrelaxed slabs cannot give converged surface energies, which the category description says they are for.  [lib/mlpeg-catalog.ts (cu-111, si-diamond, surfaces category)]
